abstract: Choriocarcinoma is present in one out of every 40,000 pregnancies. There is a great risk for incidence of the disease in women who become pregnant after 45 years of age. The clinical picture may vary and is related to the destruction of tissue and bleeding. New chemo protocols containing etoposide, cisplatin, ifosfamide, together with a resection of the focus resistant to chemotherapy, lead in most cases to the complete recovery.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は妊娠40,000例に1例の割合で発生する。45歳以降に妊娠した女性では発症リスクが高い。臨床像はさまざまであり、組織破壊と出血に関連する。エトポシド、シスプラチン、イホスファミドを含む新しい化学療法プロトコルと、化学療法に抵抗性の病巣の切除を組み合わせることで、多くの症例で完全回復に至る。
